pod_thresholds.description: DaemonSet agent pod CPU as percent of node allocatable CPU; ceiling [0%, 3%] since per-pod CPU is variable run-to-run.
Cluster scraper pod CPU as percent of node allocatable CPU; ceiling [0%, 2%] since scraper CPU is highly variable at low values.

DaemonSet agent pod memory as a percentage of node allocatable memory. Per-node spread is significant (the node hosting more pods drives higher agent memory), so this band is wider than the scraper's.
Cluster scraper pod memory as a percentage of node allocatable memory
